objective: Support multi-device flow templates with partial overrides.

acceptance.verification: Check database schema for flow_template_overrides table

acceptance.criterion: apply-template endpoint creates copied scripts and associates them
acceptance.verification: Call POST /apply-template and verify target device gets a script and flow_template_overrides entry

acceptance.criterion: sync-template endpoint synchronizes source script changes to target except overridden_fields
acceptance.verification: Call POST /sync-template and verify target script is updated with source ir_json except overridden fields

acceptance.criterion: UI provides MultiDeviceApplyDialog to apply and sync templates
acceptance.verification: MultiDeviceApplyDialog renders correctly with device list and sync functionality
